mortgage_calc_meta_title: Mortgage for Ethiopian Israelis — Eligibility Calculator | Tedros
mortgage_calc_meta_description: Mortgage for Ethiopian Israelis: check in 2 minutes if you qualify for a government loan of up to ₪600,000. Free tool in Hebrew, Amharic and English, with links to official forms.
mortgage_faq_q1: Who is eligible for the Ethiopian olim mortgage?
mortgage_faq_a1: Anyone born in Ethiopia, their direct children (second generation) aged 21+, and their spouses — provided they do not currently own property. Eligibility is binary: you either meet the criteria or you don't.
mortgage_faq_a2: ₪600,000 over 25 years: 0% interest for the first 10 years, then 2% for years 11–25. The loan amount is identical for all qualifying applicants — it does not vary by income.
mortgage_faq_a3: Yes. Children of Ethiopian-born olim qualify even if born in Israel — as long as their parents were born in Ethiopia and they themselves meet the age and ownership conditions.
mortgage_faq_a4: Apply at a participating bank with your oleh certificate or community affiliation confirmation, 3 months of payslips and bank statements. It is recommended to work with a community mortgage adviser.
mortgage_faq_a5: Israeli ID, oleh certificate or Ethiopian community affiliation confirmation, proof of Ethiopian origin (yours, a parent's or spouse's), 3 recent payslips, 3 months of bank statements, marriage certificate if married, and a land registry extract or no-property certificate.
mortgage_faq_a6: The lottery takes place once a year, usually at the end of the fiscal year. The exact date is published on the Ministry of Construction and Housing website. It is advisable to obtain an up-to-date eligibility certificate in advance — it can be issued at any time.
mortgage_faq_q7: Can this be combined with other housing programmes?
mortgage_faq_a7: It can be combined with Mechir Lamishtaken (Price for the Resident) under certain conditions, but not with other state loan tracks. Check with your bank which combinations are permitted before applying.
mortgage_faq_q8: My application was rejected — what now?
mortgage_faq_a8: You may submit a written appeal to the Ministry of Construction within 30 days. It is recommended to contact TEBEKA (free legal representation for the Ethiopian community) for assistance drafting the appeal.
